svg.title: devsecops-reference-stack delivery pipeline
svg.desc: A developer opens a pull request; CODEOWNERS review and automated checks (lint, security scans, policy, Terraform plans) gate the merge; promotion then applies dev, staging, and prod in order, each with a smoke test and rollback, staging and prod behind reviewer approval.

text.tspan: Outcome: rollback, drift issue, deployment record
devsecops-reference-stack · workflows: pr-checks, security-scan, promote -> apply (dev, staging, prod), drift-detection
